subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

It was a __distraction__.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Confusion'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the context,** "distraction"** (विचलन) implies something that interrupts or causes confusion.
 
• **"Confusion"** (भ्रांति) aligns with this definition.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **'Confusion'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Faith"** (विश्वास) means trust or belief.
 
• **"Conviction" **(आस्था) is a firmly held belief.
 
• **"Assurance"** (आश्वासन) is a positive declaration.
